# California Education Code § 49501.5(a)

Section 49501.5(a) establishes that starting with the 2022-23 school year, school districts, county superintendents, and charter schools must provide meals at no cost to students.

The key provision states: "shall make available a nutritionally adequate breakfast and a nutritionally adequate lunch free of charge and with adequate time to eat" to any pupil requesting a meal, with "a maximum of one free breakfast meal and one free lunch meal."

This requirement applies regardless of a student's eligibility for federally-funded programs, with limited exceptions outlined in the statute's subsections.
